items.information:
**PORTUGUÊS**
Sejam todos bem-vindos à segunda competição no Alto da XV Mall em parceria com o Capivara!

Essa competição terá como foco os "big cubes", portanto teremos tempos de corte generosos para que todos possam participar e se divertir. Também teremos premiação extra-oficial para as mulheres e os iniciantes melhores colocados na modalidade 3x3x3.

Nesta competição estamos arrecadando doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Todo o lucro da competição será revertido para esta campanha. Para mais informações, consulte a aba Campanha Beneficente.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).
Lembre-se de estar **pelo menos meia hora antes** de cada rodada que for participar e de fazer seu credenciamento no momento que chegar!

**ENGLISH**
Welcome to the second competition at Alto da XV Mall in partnership with Capivara!

This competition is going to have a focus on "big cubes", so we will have generous cutoff times so everyone can participate and have fun. We will also have unofficial awards to the best women and newcomers in the 3x3x3 event.

In this competition we are collecting donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. All profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. For more information, check the Charitable Campaign tab.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA).

It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Remember to be at the venue at least **thirty minutes before** each event you will participate and to check in at the moment you arrive!

Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец.
После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни).

##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность.

---

Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады.

Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді.
Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. ## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. Check out the Groups tab for more information on competition groups.

(SRB)
 
**Irig Newcommer Day 2025** je dvadeset i četvrto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. 

Ovo takmičenje učestvuje u zvaničnom **WCA Mesecu Novih Takmičara 2025**. Proces registracije obezbeđuje 50% mesta za nove takmičare. Novi takmičari su oni koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2025. godine. Takmičari koji imaju WCA ID iz 2024. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi takmičari i dalje moraju ispuniti sve zahteve za prijavu kako bi njihova prijava bila smatrana potpunom.

**Prijave će se prihvatati na sledeći način:**
* 50% mesta, određenih ograničenjem broja takmičara, obezbeđeno je za nove takmičare.
* Ako se više od 50% novih takmičara prijavi pre nego što se preostalih 50% mesta popuni povratnicima, dalja prijava će se prihvatati uobičajenim redosledom za nove takmičare i povratnike istovremeno.
* Ako mesta obezbeđena za nove takmičare ne popune novi takmičari dve nedelje pre zatvaranja registracija, preostala mesta, do ograničenja broja takmičara, biće dodeljena prijavljenim povratnicima.

------------------------

(ENG)

**Irig Newcommer Day 2025** is the 24th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. 

This competition is participating in the official **WCA Newcomer Month 2025**. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

# This competition features easy and popular events, making it perfect for newcomers.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA3NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1ce2d0d5715009d578d2d8e7e5719e7d7b032738/newcomers2025.png)

**First Time Competitors:**
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

**Judging:**
All competitors are expected to help at this competition. We will have a judging tutorial at the beginning of the day. All competitors will be assigned to judge 1 group of each of the events they are competing in. There will also be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done.

**Mystery event:**
There will be a mystery event at lunch. You only need to know how to solve a 3x3 to participate.

**4x4**
There will be no cutoff for 4x4 at this competition. The cumulative time limit is 20 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. 4x4 is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results.

## Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers Series

One day, two competitions! We are running this one-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 40% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2025** near the bottom of this page for more information).

You can choose between [Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MississaugaNewcomersA2025) and [Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MississaugaNewcomersB2025)! These competitions are identical except for the time of day they take place (morning or afternoon).

You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors.

**Deutsch**

Herzlich Willkommen zur **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig
Nach den ersten beiden Competitions 2023 und 2024 sowie den Rubik's German Nationals 2024 können wir **Leipzig** nun zu einem etablierten Cubing-Standort zählen. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet wieder eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr.

### ČEŠTINA
Tato soutěž se účastní oficiálního Měsíce nováčků WCA 2025. Při registraci bude 50 % míst vyhrazeno pro nováčky. Za nováčky se považují ti, kteří ještě na své první WCA soutěži nebyli, nebo na ní byli v roce 2025 (nemají WCA ID, nebo mají WCA ID s rokem 2025). Za vracející se soutěžící se považujeme ty, kteří mají WCA ID s rokem 2024 a méně. Všichni soutěžící musí i nadále dodržet všechny registrační požadavky, aby jejich registrace byla považována za kompletní.

Registrace budou přijímány na základě následujících kritérií:

* 50 % míst je vyhrazeno pro nové soutěžící.
* Na zbylých 50 % míst budou přijati vracející se soutěžící podle pořadí přihlášení.
* Po obsazení vyhrazené kapacity pro nováčky budou na zbývající místa přijímáni jak vracející se soutěžící, tak nováčci, podle pořadí přihlášení.
* Nebude-li vyhrazená kapacita pro nováčky naplněna 2 týdny před začátkem soutěže, budou na tato místa přijímáni i vracející se soutěžící, dle pořadí registrace.

#### **Pódium pro nováčky** 
S potěšením oznamujeme, že v kategorii 3x3x3 budeme vyhlašovat pódium pro nové soutěžící.

이 대회는 WCA Newcomer Month 2025의 일환입니다. 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. 이 때 첫 참가자란, WCA ID가 없거나 WCA ID가 2025로 시작하는 분들입니다. 기존 참가자(첫 참가자가 아닌 분)는 WCA ID가 2024 또는 그 이전의 숫자로 시작하는 분들입니다. 모든 참가자는 모든 등록 요건을 충족해야 등록이 완료된 것으로 간주됩니다. 

참가 신청은 다음 사항을 기준으로 수락됩니다:

- 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다.
- 나머지 50%는 기존 참가자에게 배정됩니다. 
- 기존 참가자가 정원의 50%를 채우기 전에 첫 참가자가 정원의 50% 이상 등록하면, 배정된 50% 안에 선착순에 의해 들지 못한 첫 참가자는 기존 참가자와 구분 없이 선착순으로 수락됩니다.
- 첫 참가자를 위한 자리가 대회 시작 2주 전 또는 참가 신청 기간 마감일이 되기 전에 모두 채워지지 않으면, 남은 자리는 기존 참가자들로부터 선착순으로 수락됩니다. 

---

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

- 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
- Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
- If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
- If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

---

items.name: Romandie Rookies 2025
items.information:
### WCA Newcomer Month

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg)

[FR]
C'est une compétition très accessible pour les débutants ! Tout le monde est le bienvenu mais si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition auparavant, c'est celle à laquelle vous devez vous inscrire !

Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024.

Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants :

50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi.
Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens.
Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous.

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Romandie Doigts Rapides 2025. Vous ne pouvez vous inscrire et participer qu'à l'une de ces compétitions.

[EN]
This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for!

This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

This competition is a series competition with Romandie Doigtes Rapides 2025. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.
